title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Onto-norms and Gender Equality: Unveiling the Invisible Gender Norms in AI Ecosystems in the Context of Africa
findings: The paper found that in AI-mediated social media spaces in Kenya, religion and culture were conveniently invoked in user-generated content to support narratives that entrench gender-based violence and expect women to remain in abusive marriages.
